comment: Budgets in bytes. Raise deliberately, never to make CI pass. shippedGzipBytes raised 2026-09-10 for the Motion runtime chunk (S7-01, 23.7 KB gz, lazy; initial load unchanged), and again 2026-09-11 to the measured 372541 B + 267 B for the process actions in bba9c51 plus S6-05's mobile alert strings. Deliberately NOT +5%: that headroom would silently absorb 18 KB of the next change's growth. Initial load is unchanged by both. Raised 2026-09-11 by 2321 B to the measured 375129 B for the lazy History widget chunk (S3-05, 1.89 KB gz) plus its strings and catalogue entry in the entry chunk; initial load still under budget. Raised 2026-09-11 by 1467 B to the measured 376596 B for the Task Manager replacement switch (S11-11): two Settings rows, the registry-backed hook and EN+RO strings, all in the entry chunk; initial load still under budget. installerBytes raised 2026-09-11 from 3148917 to the measured 4409993 B (exe 8.3 -> 12.2 MB): S4-S9 added the axum LAN server, bundled SQLite history store, mDNS and the named-pipe attach, and the budget was never re-measured after they landed. Not this commit's Task Manager feature, which is a few KB of Rust. Raised 2026-09-27 to the measured 188880 B initial / 382460 B shipped for the visual redesign: depth/glow tokens and motion keyframes in theme.css (+~1.9 KB gz CSS in the entry), AnimatedValue rolling digits inside Meter (+~0.9 KB gz), the sidebar's single morphing indicator, View Transitions navigation in AppShell and the chart head-dot/gradient fill. Deliberately NOT +5% for the same reason as before. installerBytes untouched: no installer was built this commit. HUD and mobile stay under their existing budgets (113.3 / 141.5 KB). Raised 2026-09-27 (S12-12) to the measured 189708 B initial / 384311 B shipped: +828 B / +1851 B gz for the layout fix that makes every screen fill the window and scroll inside itself: .screen/.screen-scroll/.table-scroll/.cell-fill rules in styles.css (1298 B raw), flex-chain classes on the shell wrappers, container-query dashboard columns up to 5. After removing redundant whitespace-nowrap classes. installerBytes raised to the measured 4421851 B (+11858 B): the first installer measured since S12, carrying the S12 backend (disk IOCTLs, DXGI adapter fallback, token-owner SIDs) as well as this frontend. Deliberately NOT +5 %.
